Vula i-Expert Mode ukuze uvule ukukhetha i-patch, izinketho ezikwi-custom, nezinye izici eziphezulu
Khetha ukuthi izinhlelo ezi-patched zingafakwa kanjani: i-standard, root mount, noma i-Shizuku
Vula ukuze usebenzise i-file browser eyakhelwe phakathi esikhundleni se-system picker lapho ukhetha ama-APK noma ama-keystores
